title: ShareTechnote RF Handbook — curated index for test engineers

topics.title: SNR, SINAD, SINR
topics.summary: Signal vs noise metrics; SINR is the air-interface quality measure used for NR scheduling and drive-test KPIs.
topics.test_use: Interpret drive-test SINR/RSRQ; correlate with throughput and handover margin.

topics.title: Link budget
topics.summary: Tx power, pathloss, antenna gain, margins — predicts coverage and DL/UL reach.
topics.test_use: Validate cell range, compare measured RSRP vs predicted pathloss from site data.

topics.title: Friis transmission equation
topics.summary: Free-space and baseline pathloss model between Tx/Rx antennas.
topics.test_use: Sanity-check pathloss vs distance in drive-test or chamber cal.

topics.title: dB, dBm, dBc
topics.summary: Logarithmic units for power, gain, and relative levels in RF specs and logs.
topics.test_use: Convert between dBm reports, cable loss, and amplifier gain in BTS validation.

topics.title: Time domain vs frequency domain
topics.summary: FFT/spectrum view vs time-domain waveform — foundation for spectrum analyzer and IQ capture.
topics.test_use: Debug spurs, ACLR, and filter response in lab traces.

topics.title: RF front-end Rx chain tutorial
topics.summary: LNA, mixer, filter, ADC chain from antenna to baseband.
topics.test_use: Troubleshoot desense, NF degradation, and IM products in UE or RRH receive path.

topics.title: Noise figure
topics.summary: Receiver noise contribution; sets sensitivity floor with bandwidth.
topics.test_use: Explain poor UL or weak-cell SINR when Tx power and RSRP look acceptable.

topics.title: Sensitivity / TIS context
topics.summary: Minimum detectable signal; relates to OTA receiver performance (TIS family of tests).
topics.test_use: OTA receiver validation; compare lab sensitivity vs field edge-of-cell behavior.

topics.title: Third-order intercept (IP3)
topics.summary: Linearity metric; predicts intermod distortion under strong interferers.
topics.test_use: Investigate PIM-like degradation or IM3 in multi-band RRH/UE RF paths.

topics.title: Remote radio head (RRH)
topics.summary: Distributed RU architecture, CPRI/eCPRI/RoE to BBU, tower-mounted radio.
topics.test_use: Map alarms and VSWR/PIM faults to RRH vs baseband when debugging site issues.

topics.title: Radio over Ethernet (RoE / RoC)
topics.summary: Fronthaul transport of IQ samples over Ethernet vs legacy CPRI.
topics.test_use: Fronthaul latency/bandwidth checks on open-RAN or C-RAN deployments.

topics.title: Passive intermodulation (PIM)
topics.summary: Non-linear mixing at corroded connectors/antennas causing UL desense.
topics.test_use: UL throughput collapse or high BLER on otherwise good RSRP — sweep for PIM at site.

topics.title: ACLR / ACPR
topics.summary: Adjacent-channel leakage from PA non-linearity; regulatory and coexistence metric.
topics.test_use: NR/LTE coexistence, filter/PA tuning, and spectrum mask compliance tests.

topics.title: Near field vs far field
topics.summary: Fraunhofer distance; when chamber/OTA measurements represent radiated far-field.
topics.test_use: OTA test setup, mmWave beam validation, anechoic chamber distance planning.

topics.title: Array antenna / beamforming
topics.summary: Phased-array gain and beam steering — ties to NR SSB/MIMO beam management.
topics.test_use: Explain beam-centric RSRP variation in mmWave drive tests.

topics.title: VSWR / return loss
topics.summary: Antenna-port matching; high VSWR reduces effective radiated power.
topics.test_use: Site acceptance VSWR sweeps; correlate with coverage holes or RRH alarms.

ss_rsrp.note: Received sync reference power — primary coverage KPI.

ss_rsrq.note: Quality metric combining RSRP and interference load.

ss_sinr.note: Post-FFT SINR; throughput and mobility correlate strongly.

rssi.note: Wideband received strength; not equivalent to RSRP.

bler.note: Elevated BLER under good RSRP often RF interference or mobility.

cqi.note: Scheduler input derived from channel quality reports.

nr_power_class.summary: FR1 PC3=23 dBm default; PC2/PC1.5 HPUE on n77/n78; FR2 PC1–PC7 for FWA/handheld/RedCap
nr_power_class.test_use: Cell-edge UL, HPUE validation, mmWave OTA EIRP/TRP, RedCap PC7
